scope: Full retail 4510b0 common update with actual 403cd0/403df0 motion, 479560 quad geometry, strict corner bounds and age clock. ANM lookup/release, display globals and security cookie are controlled. Callbacks zero, homing 1 and delayed turn 8, states 1/2, linear movement mode zero, no extra animation.
